_meta.title: Psalm-a-Day (World English Bible, public domain)
_meta.description: One curated verse from each of the 150 Psalms, keyed by psalm number. Ecosystem-generic 864zeros content; not tied to any one app's taxonomy. Each record carries the exact scripture plus an original plain-English rendering.
_meta.translation: WEB (World English Bible), adapted: divine name rendered as 'the Lord'
_meta.license: Public domain (WEB scripture); 'plain' renderings are original 864zeros writing
_meta.source: getbible.net v2 (WEB, book 19), cross-checked against bible-api.com; verses verified verbatim, then adapted (see note)
_meta.renderings: text = the WEB scripture (divine name adapted); plain = original 864zeros plain-English 2026 rendering, faithful to the verse's meaning (~grade 6-8), authored not quoted.
_meta.note: The divine name (WEB 'Yahweh'/'Yah') is rendered 'the Lord' as subject/possessive, and 'Lord' in direct address (vocative), for natural, KJV-familiar reading. The liturgical marker 'Selah' is dropped. Curly quotes normalized to straight; trailing conjunction punctuation of partial verses closed for standalone display; a few sentence-initial words capitalized. No review gate — author is reviewer.

psalms.text: Blessed is the man who doesn't walk in the counsel of the wicked, nor stand on the path of sinners, nor sit in the seat of scoffers.
psalms.plain: You'll be blessed when you don't take your cues from people set on wrong — not following their advice, not standing with them, not sitting with those who mock what's good.

psalms.text: Give sincere homage to the Son, lest he be angry, and you perish on the way, for his wrath will soon be kindled. Blessed are all those who take refuge in him.
psalms.plain: Honor the Son with a sincere heart. Everyone who takes shelter in him is truly blessed.

psalms.text: But you, Lord, are a shield around me, my glory, and the one who lifts up my head.
psalms.plain: But you, Lord, wrap around me like a shield; you're my honor, and the one who lifts my head back up.

psalms.text: In peace I will both lay myself down and sleep, for you, Lord alone, make me live in safety.
psalms.plain: I can lie down and sleep in peace, because you alone, Lord, keep me safe.

psalms.text: Lord, in the morning you shall hear my voice. In the morning I will lay my requests before you, and will watch expectantly.
psalms.plain: Lord, you hear my voice each morning; I lay my requests in front of you and wait, expecting you to move.

psalms.text: The Lord has heard my supplication. The Lord accepts my prayer.
psalms.plain: The Lord has heard my cry for help. The Lord accepts my prayer.

psalms.text: I will give thanks to the Lord according to his righteousness, and will sing praise to the name of the Lord Most High.
psalms.plain: I'll thank the Lord for setting things right, and sing praise to the name of the Lord Most High.

psalms.text: What is man, that you think of him? What is the son of man, that you care for him?
psalms.plain: Who are we, that you even think of us? What are people, that you care for us at all?

psalms.text: Those who know your name will put their trust in you, for you, Lord, have not forsaken those who seek you.
psalms.plain: Those who know your name trust you, because you've never abandoned anyone who looks for you, Lord.

psalms.text: Lord, you have heard the desire of the humble. You will prepare their heart. You will cause your ear to hear.
psalms.plain: Lord, you hear what the humble long for; you steady their hearts and you listen.

psalms.text: In the Lord, I take refuge. How can you say to my soul, "Flee as a bird to your mountain!"
psalms.plain: I take shelter in the Lord. So how can anyone tell me, 'Run for the hills like a scared bird'?

psalms.text: The Lord's words are flawless words, as silver refined in a clay furnace, purified seven times.
psalms.plain: The Lord's words are flawless — like silver melted down and purified seven times over.

psalms.text: I will sing to the Lord, because he has been good to me.
psalms.plain: I'll sing to the Lord, because he has been good to me.

psalms.text: There they were in great fear, for God is in the generation of the righteous.
psalms.plain: That's when fear grips them — because God is with the people who do right.

psalms.text: He who walks blamelessly does what is right, and speaks truth in his heart.
psalms.plain: It's the person who lives with integrity, does what's right, and speaks the truth from the heart.

psalms.text: You will show me the path of life. In your presence is fullness of joy. In your right hand there are pleasures forever more.
psalms.plain: You show me the path of life. Being with you fills me with joy, and there's lasting happiness at your side.

psalms.text: Keep me as the apple of your eye. Hide me under the shadow of your wings.
psalms.plain: Keep me like the apple of your eye; hide me in the shadow of your wings.

psalms.text: The Lord is my rock, my fortress, and my deliverer; my God, my rock, in whom I take refuge; my shield, and the horn of my salvation, my high tower.
psalms.plain: The Lord is my rock, my fortress, my rescuer — my God, the rock I run to, my shield and my safe high place.

psalms.text: The heavens declare the glory of God. The expanse shows his handiwork.
psalms.plain: The skies announce the glory of God; the whole sky shows off what his hands have made.

psalms.text: Some trust in chariots, and some in horses, but we trust the name of the Lord our God.
psalms.plain: Some count on chariots, some on horses — but we put our trust in the name of the Lord our God.

psalms.text: For the king trusts in the Lord. Through the loving kindness of the Most High, he shall not be moved.
psalms.plain: Because the king trusts in the Lord, and rests in the love of the Most High, he won't be shaken.

psalms.text: For he has not despised nor abhorred the affliction of the afflicted, neither has he hidden his face from him; but when he cried to him, he heard.
psalms.plain: He hasn't looked down on the suffering of the hurting or turned his face away — when they cried to him, he listened.

psalms.text: The Lord is my shepherd: I shall lack nothing.
psalms.plain: The Lord is my shepherd; I have everything I need.

psalms.text: The earth is the Lord's, with its fullness; the world, and those who dwell therein.
psalms.plain: The earth belongs to the Lord, and everything in it — the whole world and everyone living in it.

psalms.text: Show me your ways, Lord. Teach me your paths.
psalms.plain: Show me your ways, Lord. Teach me the paths you want me to walk.

psalms.text: Lord, I love the habitation of your house, the place where your glory dwells.
psalms.plain: Lord, I love being in your house, the place where your glory lives.

psalms.text: The Lord is my light and my salvation. Whom shall I fear? The Lord is the strength of my life. Of whom shall I be afraid?
psalms.plain: The Lord is my light and my rescue — so who is there to fear? The Lord is the strength of my life — so who could scare me?

psalms.text: The Lord is my strength and my shield. My heart has trusted in him, and I am helped. Therefore my heart greatly rejoices. With my song I will thank him.
psalms.plain: The Lord is my strength and my shield. My heart trusted him and he came through, so my heart overflows and I thank him with song.

psalms.text: The Lord will give strength to his people. The Lord will bless his people with peace.
psalms.plain: The Lord gives strength to his people. The Lord blesses his people with peace.

psalms.text: For his anger is but for a moment. His favor is for a lifetime. Weeping may stay for the night, but joy comes in the morning.
psalms.plain: His anger lasts a moment, but his favor lasts a lifetime. Crying may last through the night, but joy comes in the morning.

psalms.text: Be strong, and let your heart take courage, all you who hope in the Lord.
psalms.plain: Be strong, and let your heart take courage, all of you who put your hope in the Lord.

psalms.text: You are my hiding place. You will preserve me from trouble. You will surround me with songs of deliverance.
psalms.plain: You're my hiding place. You keep me out of trouble and surround me with songs of rescue.

psalms.text: Our soul has waited for the Lord. He is our help and our shield.
psalms.plain: We wait for the Lord; he is our help and our shield.

psalms.text: The Lord is near to those who have a broken heart, and saves those who have a crushed spirit.
psalms.plain: The Lord is close to the brokenhearted, and he rescues those whose spirits are crushed.

psalms.text: My soul shall be joyful in the Lord. It shall rejoice in his salvation.
psalms.plain: Then my soul will be full of joy in the Lord, glad in the rescue he brings.

psalms.text: For with you is the spring of life. In your light shall we see light.
psalms.plain: With you is the very source of life; in your light, we finally see clearly.

psalms.text: Also delight yourself in the Lord, and he will give you the desires of your heart.
psalms.plain: Take your delight in the Lord, and he will give you what your heart most deeply wants.

psalms.text: For in you, Lord, do I hope. You will answer, Lord my God.
psalms.plain: Lord, it's you I'm hoping in; you will answer, Lord my God.

psalms.text: Now, Lord, what do I wait for? My hope is in you.
psalms.plain: So now, Lord, what am I waiting for? My hope is in you.

psalms.text: I waited patiently for the Lord. He turned to me, and heard my cry.
psalms.plain: I waited patiently for the Lord, and he turned to me and heard my cry.

psalms.text: Blessed is he who considers the poor. The Lord will deliver him in the day of evil.
psalms.plain: Blessed is the one who looks out for the weak; the Lord will help them when trouble comes.

psalms.text: Why are you in despair, my soul? Why are you disturbed within me? Hope in God! For I shall still praise him, the saving help of my countenance, and my God.
psalms.plain: Why so discouraged, my soul? Why so restless? Put your hope in God — I'll praise him again; he is my Savior and my God.

psalms.text: Oh, send out your light and your truth. Let them lead me. Let them bring me to your holy hill, to your tents.
psalms.plain: Send out your light and your truth to guide me; let them lead me home to you.

psalms.text: In God we have made our boast all day long, we will give thanks to your name forever.
psalms.plain: In God we've boasted all day long, and we'll thank your name forever.

psalms.text: Your throne, God, is forever and ever. A scepter of equity is the scepter of your kingdom.
psalms.plain: Your throne, God, stands forever and ever; you rule with fairness.

psalms.text: Be still, and know that I am God. I will be exalted among the nations. I will be exalted in the earth.
psalms.plain: Be still, and know that I am God. I will be honored among the nations; I will be honored over all the earth.

psalms.text: Oh clap your hands, all you nations. Shout to God with the voice of triumph!
psalms.plain: Clap your hands, everyone! Shout to God with joyful triumph!

psalms.text: For this God is our God forever and ever. He will be our guide even to death.
psalms.plain: This God is our God forever and ever; he will be our guide to the very end.

psalms.text: But God will redeem my soul from the power of Sheol, for he will receive me.
psalms.plain: But God will redeem my life from the grave; he will surely take me to himself.

psalms.text: Call on me in the day of trouble. I will deliver you, and you will honor me.
psalms.plain: Call on me when you're in trouble. I'll rescue you, and you'll honor me.

psalms.text: Create in me a clean heart, O God. Renew a right spirit within me.
psalms.plain: Create a clean heart in me, God, and put a right spirit back inside me.

psalms.text: But as for me, I am like a green olive tree in God's house. I trust in God's loving kindness forever and ever.
psalms.plain: But I'm like a green olive tree growing in God's house; I trust in God's love forever and ever.

psalms.text: Oh that the salvation of Israel would come out of Zion! When God brings back his people from captivity, then Jacob shall rejoice, and Israel shall be glad.
psalms.plain: How I long for rescue to come — when God restores his people, there'll be nothing but gladness.

psalms.text: Behold, God is my helper. The Lord is the one who sustains my soul.
psalms.plain: Look — God is my helper. The Lord is the one holding my life together.

psalms.text: Cast your burden on the Lord, and he will sustain you. He will never allow the righteous to be moved.
psalms.plain: Hand your burden over to the Lord, and he'll carry you; he'll never let a good person collapse.

psalms.text: When I am afraid, I will put my trust in you.
psalms.plain: When I'm afraid, I'll put my trust in you.

psalms.text: Be merciful to me, God, be merciful to me, for my soul takes refuge in you. Yes, in the shadow of your wings, I will take refuge, until disaster has passed.
psalms.plain: Be merciful to me, God — my soul runs to you for shelter. I'll hide in the shadow of your wings until the danger passes.

psalms.text: So that men shall say, "Most certainly there is a reward for the righteous. Most certainly there is a God who judges the earth."
psalms.plain: Then people will say, 'There really is a reward for those who do right; there really is a God who brings justice to the earth.'

psalms.text: But I will sing of your strength. Yes, I will sing aloud of your loving kindness in the morning. For you have been my high tower, a refuge in the day of my distress.
psalms.plain: But I'll sing about your strength; in the morning I'll sing out loud about your love, because you've been my safe tower on my hardest days.

psalms.text: Through God we shall do valiantly, for it is he who will tread down our adversaries.
psalms.plain: With God we'll do great things, because he's the one who tramples down what stands against us.

psalms.text: From the end of the earth, I will call to you, when my heart is overwhelmed. Lead me to the rock that is higher than I.
psalms.plain: From the ends of the earth I call to you when my heart is overwhelmed; lead me to the rock that's higher than I can reach.

psalms.text: Trust in him at all times, you people. Pour out your heart before him. God is a refuge for us.
psalms.plain: Trust him at all times, everyone. Pour your heart out to him — God is a refuge for us.

psalms.text: God, you are my God. I will earnestly seek you. My soul thirsts for you. My flesh longs for you, in a dry and weary land, where there is no water.
psalms.plain: God, you are my God, and I search for you; my whole self thirsts for you like a dry, parched land with no water.

psalms.text: The righteous shall be glad in the Lord, and shall take refuge in him. All the upright in heart shall praise him!
psalms.plain: The good will find their joy in the Lord and run to him for shelter, and everyone whose heart is right will praise him.

psalms.text: You crown the year with your bounty. Your carts overflow with abundance.
psalms.plain: You crown the year with your goodness; abundance overflows wherever you go.

psalms.text: Blessed be God, who has not turned away my prayer, nor his loving kindness from me.
psalms.plain: Blessed be God, who didn't turn my prayer away or hold back his love from me.

psalms.text: May God be merciful to us, bless us, and cause his face to shine on us.
psalms.plain: May God be gracious to us, bless us, and let his face shine on us.

psalms.text: Blessed be the Lord, who daily bears our burdens, even the God who is our salvation.
psalms.plain: Blessed be the Lord, who carries our burdens every single day — the God who is our salvation.

psalms.text: I will praise the name of God with a song, and will magnify him with thanksgiving.
psalms.plain: I'll praise God's name with a song and lift him high with thanks.

psalms.text: Let all those who seek you rejoice and be glad in you. Let those who love your salvation continually say, "Let God be exalted!"
psalms.plain: Let everyone who looks for you be glad and rejoice in you; let those who love your rescue always say, 'God is great!'

psalms.text: But I will always hope, and will add to all of your praise.
psalms.plain: But as for me, I'll never stop hoping, and I'll praise you more and more.

psalms.text: Praise be to the Lord God, the God of Israel, who alone does marvelous deeds.
psalms.plain: Praise be to the Lord God, the God of Israel, who alone does wonderful things.

psalms.text: My flesh and my heart fails, but God is the strength of my heart and my portion forever.
psalms.plain: My body and my heart may give out, but God is the strength of my heart and all I'll ever need.

psalms.text: Yet God is my King of old, working salvation in the midst of the earth.
psalms.plain: Yet God has been my King from long ago, working rescue right here on the earth.

psalms.text: We give thanks to you, God. We give thanks, for your Name is near. Men tell about your wondrous works.
psalms.plain: We thank you, God, we thank you — your name is near, and people tell of the wonderful things you do.

psalms.text: When God arose to judgment, to save all the afflicted ones of the earth.
psalms.plain: When God stood up to bring justice, to save all the hurting people of the earth.

psalms.text: You are the God who does wonders. You have made your strength known among the peoples.
psalms.plain: You are the God who does wonders; you've shown your strength among the peoples.

psalms.text: That they might set their hope in God, and not forget the works of God, but keep his commandments.
psalms.plain: so they'd put their hope in God, never forget the things he's done, and keep his commands.

psalms.text: So we, your people and sheep of your pasture, will give you thanks forever. We will praise you forever, to all generations.
psalms.plain: Then we, your people, the sheep you care for, will thank you forever and praise you for all time.

psalms.text: Turn us again, God. Cause your face to shine, and we will be saved.
psalms.plain: Bring us back, God. Let your face shine on us, and we'll be saved.

psalms.text: I am the Lord your God, who brought you up out of the land of Egypt. Open your mouth wide, and I will fill it.
psalms.plain: I am the Lord your God, the one who brought you out of Egypt. Open your mouth wide, and I'll fill it.

psalms.text: Defend the weak, the poor, and the fatherless. Maintain the rights of the poor and oppressed.
psalms.plain: Stand up for the weak, the poor, and the fatherless; make sure the poor and the oppressed get justice.

psalms.text: That they may know that you alone, whose name is the Lord, are the Most High over all the earth.
psalms.plain: so they'll know that you alone — whose name is the Lord — are the Most High over all the earth.

psalms.text: For the Lord God is a sun and a shield. The Lord will give grace and glory. He withholds no good thing from those who walk blamelessly.
psalms.plain: The Lord God is a sun and a shield; the Lord gives grace and honor, and holds back nothing good from those who live with integrity.

psalms.text: I will hear what God, the Lord, will speak, for he will speak peace to his people, his saints; but let them not turn again to folly.
psalms.plain: I'll listen to what God the Lord says, because he speaks peace to his people — so let them not slip back into foolishness.

psalms.text: For you, Lord, are good, and ready to forgive; abundant in loving kindness to all those who call on you.
psalms.plain: You, Lord, are good and ready to forgive, overflowing with love for everyone who calls on you.

psalms.text: Those who sing as well as those who dance say, "All my springs are in you."
psalms.plain: As they sing and dance they say, 'Everything good in me flows from you.'

psalms.text: Lord, the God of my salvation, I have cried day and night before you.
psalms.plain: Lord, God of my salvation, I've cried out to you day and night.

psalms.text: I will sing of the loving kindness of the Lord forever. With my mouth, I will make known your faithfulness to all generations.
psalms.plain: I'll sing about the Lord's love forever; I'll tell every generation how faithful you are.

psalms.text: So teach us to number our days, that we may gain a heart of wisdom.
psalms.plain: Teach us to make our days count, so we grow wise in heart.

psalms.text: He who dwells in the secret place of the Most High will rest in the shadow of the Almighty.
psalms.plain: Whoever lives in the shelter of the Most High will rest in the shadow of the Almighty.

psalms.text: It is a good thing to give thanks to the Lord, to sing praises to your name, Most High.
psalms.plain: It's a good thing to thank the Lord, and to sing praise to your name, Most High.

psalms.text: The Lord reigns! He is clothed with majesty! The Lord is armed with strength. The world also is established. It can't be moved.
psalms.plain: The Lord reigns, clothed in majesty; the Lord is armed with strength. The world stands firm and cannot be shaken.

psalms.text: In the multitude of my thoughts within me, your comforts delight my soul.
psalms.plain: When worries pile up inside me, your comfort brings my soul back to joy.

psalms.text: Oh come, let's sing to the Lord. Let's shout aloud to the rock of our salvation!
psalms.plain: Come on, let's sing to the Lord! Let's shout for joy to the rock who saves us!

psalms.text: Sing to the Lord a new song! Sing to the Lord, all the earth.
psalms.plain: Sing a new song to the Lord! Sing to the Lord, all the earth!

psalms.text: The Lord reigns! Let the earth rejoice! Let the multitude of islands be glad!
psalms.plain: The Lord reigns! Let the earth be glad; let the distant shores rejoice!

psalms.text: Make a joyful noise to the Lord, all the earth! Burst out and sing for joy, yes, sing praises!
psalms.plain: Shout for joy to the Lord, all the earth! Burst into song — sing your praises!

psalms.text: Exalt the Lord, our God. Worship at his holy hill, for the Lord, our God, is holy!
psalms.plain: Lift high the Lord our God; worship at his holy hill, because the Lord our God is holy.

psalms.text: For the Lord is good. His loving kindness endures forever, his faithfulness to all generations.
psalms.plain: The Lord is good; his love never runs out, and his faithfulness carries on through every generation.

psalms.text: I will be careful to live a blameless life. When will you come to me? I will walk within my house with a blameless heart.
psalms.plain: I'll be careful to live an honest life; I'll walk through my own home with integrity.

psalms.text: He has responded to the prayer of the destitute, and has not despised their prayer.
psalms.plain: He has answered the prayer of the destitute and hasn't turned their prayer away.

psalms.text: The Lord is merciful and gracious, slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness.
psalms.plain: The Lord is kind and gracious, patient, and overflowing with love.

psalms.text: Lord, how many are your works! In wisdom have you made them all. The earth is full of your riches.
psalms.plain: Lord, how many are the things you've made! You made them all with wisdom; the earth is full of what you've given.

psalms.text: Give thanks to the Lord! Call on his name! Make his doings known among the peoples.
psalms.plain: Thank the Lord! Call on his name! Tell the peoples everywhere what he has done.

psalms.text: Praise the Lord! Give thanks to the Lord, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.
psalms.plain: Praise the Lord! Thank the Lord, because he is good, and his love lasts forever.

psalms.text: For he satisfies the longing soul. He fills the hungry soul with good.
psalms.plain: He satisfies the thirsty soul and fills the hungry with good things.

psalms.text: For your loving kindness is great above the heavens. Your faithfulness reaches to the skies.
psalms.plain: Your love is higher than the heavens; your faithfulness reaches the skies.

psalms.text: Help me, Lord, my God. Save me according to your loving kindness.
psalms.plain: Help me, Lord my God; save me because of your love.

psalms.text: The Lord says to my Lord, "Sit at my right hand, until I make your enemies your footstool for your feet."
psalms.plain: The Lord says to my Lord, 'Sit at my right hand until I put your enemies under your feet.'

psalms.text: The fear of the Lord is the beginning of wisdom. All those who do his work have a good understanding. His praise endures forever!
psalms.plain: Wisdom begins with taking the Lord seriously; everyone who lives it out gains real understanding, and his praise goes on forever.

psalms.text: He will not be afraid of evil news. His heart is steadfast, trusting in the Lord.
psalms.plain: They won't be afraid of bad news; their heart is steady, trusting in the Lord.

psalms.text: From the rising of the sun to the going down of the same, the Lord's name is to be praised.
psalms.plain: From sunrise to sunset, the Lord's name deserves praise.

psalms.text: Tremble, you earth, at the presence of the Lord, at the presence of the God of Jacob.
psalms.plain: Tremble, earth, at the presence of the Lord, at the presence of the God of Jacob.

psalms.text: Not to us, Lord, not to us, but to your name give glory, for your loving kindness, and for your truth's sake.
psalms.plain: Not to us, Lord, not to us, but to your name give the glory, because of your love and your faithfulness.

psalms.text: Return to your rest, my soul, for the Lord has dealt bountifully with you.
psalms.plain: Settle down again, my soul, because the Lord has been so good to you.

psalms.text: For his loving kindness is great toward us. The Lord's faithfulness endures forever. Praise the Lord!
psalms.plain: His love for us is huge, and the Lord's faithfulness lasts forever. Praise the Lord!

psalms.text: This is the day that the Lord has made. We will rejoice and be glad in it!
psalms.plain: This is the day the Lord has made; let's rejoice and be glad in it!

psalms.text: Your word is a lamp to my feet, and a light for my path.
psalms.plain: Your word is a lamp for my feet and a light for my path.

psalms.text: In my distress, I cried to the Lord. He answered me.
psalms.plain: When I was in trouble, I called out to the Lord, and he answered me.

psalms.text: My help comes from the Lord, who made heaven and earth.
psalms.plain: My help comes from the Lord, the Maker of heaven and earth.

psalms.text: I was glad when they said to me, "Let's go to the Lord's house!"
psalms.plain: I was so glad when they said to me, 'Let's go to the Lord's house!'

psalms.text: Behold, as the eyes of servants look to the hand of their master, as the eyes of a maid to the hand of her mistress; so our eyes look to the Lord, our God, until he has mercy on us.
psalms.plain: Just as servants watch their master's hand, we keep our eyes on the Lord our God until he shows us mercy.

psalms.text: Our help is in the Lord's name, who made heaven and earth.
psalms.plain: Our help is in the name of the Lord, the Maker of heaven and earth.

psalms.text: Those who trust in the Lord are as Mount Zion, which can't be moved, but remains forever.
psalms.plain: Those who trust in the Lord are like Mount Zion — unshakable, standing forever.

psalms.text: Those who sow in tears will reap in joy.
psalms.plain: Those who plant in tears will bring in a harvest of joy.

psalms.text: Unless the Lord builds the house, they labor in vain who build it. Unless the Lord watches over the city, the watchman guards it in vain.
psalms.plain: Unless the Lord builds the house, the builders are working for nothing; unless the Lord guards the city, the watchman stays awake for nothing.

psalms.text: Blessed is everyone who fears the Lord, who walks in his ways.
psalms.plain: Blessed is everyone who honors the Lord and walks in his ways.

psalms.text: Many times they have afflicted me from my youth up, yet they have not prevailed against me.
psalms.plain: They've hit me hard again and again since I was young — but they've never beaten me.

psalms.text: I wait for the Lord. My soul waits. I hope in his word.
psalms.plain: I wait for the Lord; my whole soul waits, and I put my hope in his word.

psalms.text: Surely I have stilled and quieted my soul, like a weaned child with his mother, like a weaned child is my soul within me.
psalms.plain: I've calmed and quieted my soul, like a small child resting content with its mother.

psalms.text: I will abundantly bless her provision. I will satisfy her poor with bread.
psalms.plain: I will bless this place with plenty; I'll satisfy its poor with bread.

psalms.text: See how good and how pleasant it is for brothers to live together in unity!
psalms.plain: Look how good and how pleasant it is when people live together in unity!

psalms.text: Lift up your hands in the sanctuary. Praise the Lord!
psalms.plain: Lift up your hands in worship, and praise the Lord.

psalms.text: Praise the Lord, for the Lord is good. Sing praises to his name, for that is pleasant.
psalms.plain: Praise the Lord, because the Lord is good; sing praise to his name, because it's a delight.

psalms.text: Give thanks to the Lord, for he is good; for his loving kindness endures forever.
psalms.plain: Thank the Lord, because he is good; his love lasts forever.

psalms.text: By the rivers of Babylon, there we sat down. Yes, we wept, when we remembered Zion.
psalms.plain: By the rivers of Babylon we sat down and wept, remembering home.

psalms.text: The Lord will fulfill that which concerns me; your loving kindness, Lord, endures forever. Don't forsake the works of your own hands.
psalms.plain: The Lord will finish what he started for me; your love, Lord, lasts forever — don't walk away from what your hands have made.

psalms.text: I will give thanks to you, for I am fearfully and wonderfully made. Your works are wonderful. My soul knows that very well.
psalms.plain: I thank you, because I'm remarkably and wonderfully made; your work is amazing — I know that deep down.

psalms.text: I know that the Lord will maintain the cause of the afflicted, and justice for the needy.
psalms.plain: I know the Lord will stand up for the suffering and bring justice for those in need.

psalms.text: Set a watch, Lord, before my mouth. Keep the door of my lips.
psalms.plain: Lord, set a guard over my mouth; keep watch over the door of my lips.

psalms.text: I cried to you, Lord. I said, "You are my refuge, my portion in the land of the living."
psalms.plain: I cried out to you, Lord; I said, 'You are my refuge, all I have in the land of the living.'

psalms.text: Cause me to hear your loving kindness in the morning, for I trust in you. Cause me to know the way in which I should walk, for I lift up my soul to you.
psalms.plain: Let me hear about your love each morning, because I trust you; show me the way to go, because I lift up my soul to you.

psalms.text: Happy are the people who are in such a situation. Happy are the people whose God is the Lord.
psalms.plain: Happy are the people who have all this — happy are the people whose God is the Lord.

psalms.text: The Lord is near to all those who call on him, to all who call on him in truth.
psalms.plain: The Lord is close to everyone who calls on him, to all who call on him sincerely.

psalms.text: Happy is he who has the God of Jacob for his help, whose hope is in the Lord, his God.
psalms.plain: Happy is the person whose helper is the God of Jacob, whose hope rests in the Lord their God.

psalms.text: He heals the broken in heart, and binds up their wounds.
psalms.plain: He heals the brokenhearted and bandages their wounds.

psalms.text: Let them praise the Lord's name, for his name alone is exalted. His glory is above the earth and the heavens.
psalms.plain: Let them praise the name of the Lord, because his name alone stands above all — his glory over earth and sky.

psalms.text: For the Lord takes pleasure in his people. He crowns the humble with salvation.
psalms.plain: The Lord delights in his people; he crowns the humble with rescue.

psalms.text: Let everything that has breath praise the Lord! Praise the Lord!
psalms.plain: Let everything that has breath praise the Lord! Praise the Lord!
